# wso2is_group_members (Resource)

Manages the complete list of members of a group. The provider removes any user who is not in the list. Use only one `wso2is_group_members` for each group. To import, use the group ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_user" "alice" {
  username = "alice"
  email    = "alice@example.com"
  password = var.alice_password
}

resource "wso2is_group" "developers" {
  name = "developers"
}

resource "wso2is_group_members" "developers" {
  group_id = wso2is_group.developers.id
  user_ids = [wso2is_user.alice.id]
}

variable "alice_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group ID.
- `user_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the member users.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `group_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_group_members.developers <group_id>
```
